Now need to answer: "Which member of the crew of this flight was born on the same day as someone who was the head coach of a professional NBA basketball team before 2022?"

We must match birthdate. Let's compile dates of crew and coach Doc Rivers.

Crew dates:

- George Zamka: 1962-06-29

Doc Rivers: 1961-10-13.

No match.

But maybe coach other: Steve Clifford (born 1964-02-02). No match.

Stan Van Gundy: 1958? not.

But perhaps we consider "head coach of a professional NBA basketball team" meaning coach of the Orlando Magic (Doc Rivers) but also "head coach before 2022" could include someone else whose birthdate matches one crew member even if from other team.

Let's search NBA coaches birthdates: maybe "Gregg Popovich" (born 1958-09-20). Not match.

"Tyronn Lue" (born 1971).

"Steve Kerr" (born 1963-09-27). No match.

"Paul Westphal" (born 1952-09-04). No.

"Erik Spoelstra" 1969-10-12. Not.

"Jim O'Brien" 1962-02-15. Not.

Let's list crew members again to find potential matches with coaches:

- 1961-09-17 equal to? Coach born Sep 17? Coach "Lightning McAl",
Let's search list for NBA head coach born Sep 17.

Steve Clifford born Sep 17 1961. That's the same date as Pamela Melroy. So crew member Pamela Melroy matches with Steve Clifford, who was head coach of Orlando Magic before 2022 (2012-2015). Yes that fits.

Thus answer: Pamela Melroy.

Provide citation for Pamela Melroy birthdate (source earlier) and Steve Clifford birthdate (source from search snippet). Also note Orlando Magic founded 1989 in Florida.

Let's fetch Steve Clifford page.

The NBA head coach who has the same birthday is **Steve Clifford** (born 17 September 1961) who served as the head coach of the Orlando Magic (an NBA team based in Florida that was founded in 1989, i.e., after 1988) before 2022【Steve_Clifford page】.
